raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Starting with batch 12, rows from the new 'v2' collector have timestamps shifted +6 hours, probably UTC instead of local time. The earliest v2 rows sit at 12:00 while legacy rows open at 06:00, and late-evening v2 transactions spill into 00:00-06:00 of the next day. That explains the out-of-hours alerts and the phantom 36-row 2026-01-19 partition. Subtracting 6 hours from v2 timestamps before deriving txn_ts and txn_date fixes it, though the offset is inferred from the data and no change note documents it.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
